entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sold me is a complete piece of junk. I want my money back, and I want it back now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're unhappy with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What's the issue? The pulse tracker is completely broken! It's not working, plain and simple. It gives me readings that are all over the place or just dashes. It also won't sync that garbage data to my phone. It's defective!
Okay, I understand. It sounds very frustrating when a feature isn't working as expected. Let me just pull up your purchase details. One moment.

You'd better. I've had this thing for just over a month and it's useless. If you try to give me the runaround, I'll just dispute the charge and I'll be leaving reviews on every site I can find. This is ridiculous. Get me your manager.
Sir, there's no need for that. I'm confident I can resolve this for you. I'm checking the policy right now. I can see you received the VeloBand 35 days ago.
And? Are you going to tell me I'm out of luck because your product is broken?

Not at all. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. Since you're reporting the device as defective, I can go ahead and process a full return and refund for you right now.
Oh. You... you can? A full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated it on my end. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the band in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Well... okay then. That's... that's great. I appreciate that. So the label is on its way to my email?

It should be in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the returned item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
